name: Point-of-Sale Card Breach
description: Malware on point-of-sale systems harvests payment card data across stores until fraud patterns trace back to the chain.
assumptions: Point-to-point encryption coverage is reflected in the vulnerability estimate.
Primary loss covers forensics, containment, and reissuance support.
Secondary loss includes card-brand assessments and customer attrition.

name: Ransomware Freezes Distribution and Stores
description: Ransomware takes down warehouse management and store ordering; shelves thin out and perishables spoil while systems are restored.
asset: Warehouse management and store ordering systems
assumptions: Perishable spoilage begins within 48 hours of distribution stopping.
Stores can run degraded point-of-sale independently of ordering.
Secondary loss covers customer defection to competitors.

name: Supplier Ordering Platform Compromise
description: An attacker manipulates the EDI/ordering platform, corrupting orders and invoices across hundreds of suppliers before detection.
assumptions: A loss event is tampering that reaches ordering or invoicing.
Primary loss covers reconciliation, expedited orders, and write-offs.

name: Loyalty Program Account Takeover
description: Credential-stuffing campaigns drain loyalty points and expose member profiles across the chain's app and website.
effect: Points theft and member PII exposure
assumptions: A loss event is a campaign taking over active member accounts.
Points made whole to members are primary loss.
Secondary loss covers notification duties and program-trust damage.

name: Refrigeration Monitoring Outage
description: The networked refrigeration monitoring platform is disabled or tampered with; temperature excursions go undetected, forcing product disposal.
asset: Cold-chain monitoring across stores and warehouses
assumptions: Food-safety rules force disposal whenever monitoring gaps exceed thresholds.
Manual temperature checks cap the excursion window.
Secondary loss covers regulatory scrutiny and disposal disputes.
